{{Quote|Nineteen hours ago, we lost contact with the Jedi enclave on Rhinnal. The Republic patrol frigate ''Toron Voq'' went to investigate. The vessel's crew reported the enclave had been slaughtered. No survivors. As we were speaking, the ''Toron Voq'' came under heavy fire.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi chapter house (Rhinnal)|Jedi enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] was '''destroyed''' by the ''[[Red Reaper]]'', the flagship of the xenophobic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]]. The simultaneous [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of so many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] affected [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] greatly, and the Republic dispatched the patrol frigate ''[[Toron Voq]]'' to Rhinnal in order to investigate when the Enclave did not respond to communications. The ''Toron Voq'' discovered the ''Red Reaper'' in the process of massacring the enclave, and it was barely able to send an image of the attacker before it was destroyed.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
